query: Please implement a multi-tenant ordering system for store management and online ordering and cashier functions. The system should have functionalities such as store location, shopping cart, appointment, payment, and order status viewing. Users should be able to log in, browse menus, place orders, make appointments, and pay. The system should also have store management functions, including basic data configuration, staff management, and transaction settlement. Additionally, the system should have operational management functions, including merchant management and operational reports. Use light beige for the background and sienna for components.
